headline: Israeli Cybersecurity Firm Sentra Raises $150 Million to Protect AI Agent Data
summary: Israeli cybersecurity company Sentra raised $150 million to address the expanding use of AI agents within organizations and the growing need to protect exposed enterprise data.
why: Enterprise adoption of artificial intelligence introduces critical data security vulnerabilities, fueling venture capital investment in specialized cloud data security solutions.

impacts.name: Cybersecurity
impacts.why: A $150 million funding round highlights investor confidence in cybersecurity solutions addressing AI data risks.
